sinopsis.es: Los últimos habitantes de Ginostra, una veintena de ancianos aislados del mundo en este pequeño pueblo aferrado a las laderas del volcán Stromboli, viven al ritmo de una naturaleza tan generosa como destructiva. Toda su vida se ha forjado en una relación personalizada con esta naturaleza y con el volcán.
sinopsis.en: The last inhabitants of Ginostra, about twenty elderly people cut off from the world in this small village clinging to the slopes of the Stromboli volcano, live to the rhythm of a nature that is as generous as it is destructive. Their entire lives have been shaped by a personalized relationship with this nature and with the volcano.
